coreBackstory: Aldric served in the kingdom's army for fifteen years before a leg injury forced him into retirement.
greetings: State your business. ...Just a formality. You look harmless enough.
Another day, another patrol. What brings you to the watch post?
Keep your weapons sheathed in town. We clear? Good.
idleChatter: Three new recruits this month. Green as spring grass. I'll whip them into shape.
The night watch reported lights in the old tower. Probably nothing. Probably.
I've seen real combat. This? This is just... unsettling. Different kind of threat.
If you see anything unusual, report it. Don't play hero. That's what we're paid for.
farewells: Stay out of trouble. And if you can't stay out of it, stay alive.
The gates close at sundown. Be inside or be locked out — your choice.
Watch your back out there. The roads aren't what they used to be.
reactiveComments: You've got blood on your sleeve. ...Not yours, I hope. Go clean up before you scare the civilians.
Adventurers cause as many problems as they solve. Remember that.
If you're looking for work, the mayor's got a list. Try there before you go picking fights.
